exercises.q: The scientist ______ on this project for over a decade, and the results are finally emerging.
exercises.explain: for over a decade 强调从过去持续到现在且可能继续，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: It is the third time that the committee ______ this proposal.
exercises.explain: It is the third time that 句型要求从句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The findings of the study ______ (publish) in several leading journals so far.
exercises.explain: so far 提示现在完成时，findings 与 publish 是被动关系。

exercises.q: She ______ (devote) herself to medical research since she graduated from university.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语，主句用现在完成时表示持续。

exercises.q: By the time the authorities issued the warning, the disease ______ already ______ (spread) to several cities.
exercises.explain: by the time 表示“到过去某时为止”，用过去完成时，spread 过去分词与原形同形。

exercises.q: The sentence "The committee has been reviewing the proposal for three weeks." implies the review is still ongoing.
exercises.explain: 现在完成进行时表示动作从过去持续到现在且可能继续。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has left the company for two years." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: leave 是短暂性动词，不能与 for + 时间段连用，应改为 has been away from。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using passive voice: Researchers have conducted extensive studies on the topic.
exercises.answer: Extensive studies have been conducted on the topic by researchers.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时被动语态结构为 have/has been + 过去分词。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "since": The organization has been operating for twenty years.
exercises.answer: The organization has been operating since twenty years ago.
exercises.explain: since + 时间点可替换 for + 时间段，表达相同持续含义。

exercises.answer: The committee has reached a consensus on the new policy.
exercises.explain: reach 是及物动词，主动语态中不需要 been。

exercises.q: Many studies have been conducted on this issue, but few has produced conclusive results.
exercises.answer: Many studies have been conducted on this issue, but few have produced conclusive results.
exercises.explain: few 指代可数名词复数，谓语动词应用 have 而非 has。

grammar.key: Modal Verbs for Speculation / 表示推测的情态动词
grammar.title: 情态动词表推测：must / may / might / could / can’t 的系统用法与高中拓展
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verbs for Speculation: must, may, might, could, can’t and Their Extended Uses
grammar.usage:
情态动词表推测是高中英语的重要语法板块，核心结构为“情态动词 + 动词原形”表示对现在或将来情况的推测，以及“情态动词 + have done”表示对过去情况的推测。肯定推测中，must 语气最强，表示“一定、肯定”；may / might / could 表示“可能、也许”，语气依次减弱；否定推测中，can’t / couldn’t 表示“不可能”，注意 must 的否定推测不能直接用 mustn’t，而要用 can’t 或 couldn’t。疑问句中通常用 can 或 could 来询问可能性，例如“Can/Could it be true?”。

初中阶段主要掌握 must、may、might、can’t 后接动词原形的基本用法，能够区分肯定推测与否定推测。高中阶段则进一步要求掌握“情态动词 + have done”结构，如 must have done（过去一定做过）、may/might have done（过去可能做过）、can’t/couldn’t have done（过去不可能做过），并能在完形填空、阅读理解和书面表达中准确判断推测的时间指向。此外，高中还需注意 could 在推测用法中并非 can 的过去式，而是表示现在或将来的可能性，语气比 may 更弱、更委婉。

与近义结构对比时需注意：must 表推测只用于肯定句，否定推测用 can’t；may 和 might 均可用于肯定和否定推测，但 might 语气更弱，且可用于虚拟语气中表示更不确定的推测；could 既可表能力，也可表推测，需根据语境区分。在书面表达中，使用 might 或 could 比 may 更显委婉、客观，适合议论文中表达留有余地的判断。

易错点包括：一是混淆 mustn’t 与 can’t 的推测用法，mustn’t 表示“禁止”，不表推测；二是“情态动词 + have done”结构中误用动词原形，如把 must have been 写成 must be；三是忽略时间状语对推测结构的提示，如 yesterday、last night 等提示过去推测，now、today 等提示现在推测；四是把 could 一律理解为 can 的过去式，忽略其表示现在或将来的推测功能。
forms: 肯定推测（现在/将来）：must / may / might / could + 动词原形
否定推测（现在/将来）：can’t / couldn’t / may not / might not + 动词原形
肯定推测（过去）：must / may / might / could + have done
否定推测（过去）：can’t / couldn’t / may not / might not + have done
疑问推测：Can / Could + 主语 + 动词原形...?
委婉推测（书面语）：It might/could be + 名词/形容词 + that...
notes: mustn’t 表示“禁止、不准”，不能用于否定推测；“不可能”要用 can’t 或 couldn’t。
高考书面表达中，用 might 或 could 代替 may 可使语气更委婉、客观，符合议论文语域要求。
“情态动词 + have done”只用于对过去的推测，不能与表示现在的时间状语连用。
could 表推测时不是 can 的过去式，而是表示现在或将来的可能性，语气比 may 更弱。
在完形填空中，需根据上下文线索判断推测的确定程度：证据充分用 must，证据不足用 might/could，与事实矛盾用 can’t。

examples.en: He must be tired after working all day.
examples.cn: 他工作了一整天，一定很累了。

examples.en: She may be in the library now.
examples.cn: 她现在可能在图书馆。

examples.en: That can’t be true—I saw it with my own eyes.
examples.cn: 那不可能是真的——我亲眼看见的。

examples.en: They might have missed the train because of the heavy traffic.
examples.cn: 由于交通拥堵，他们可能错过了火车。

examples.en: The lights are off, so they couldn’t have been at home last night.
examples.cn: 灯都关着，所以他们昨晚不可能在家。

examples.en: It could be argued that excessive screen time might contribute to a decline in face-to-face communication.
examples.cn: 可以说，过度使用电子屏幕可能会减少面对面的交流。

exercises.q: The lights are on in the classroom. Someone ______ be inside.
exercises.explain: could 表示“可能”，符合对现在情况的推测。

exercises.q: It's only 6 a.m. Dad ______ be sleeping now. He always gets up at 5.
exercises.explain: can't 表示否定推测“不可能”，与爸爸总是5点起床的事实相符。

exercises.q: I'm not sure where Tom is. He ______ be in the library.
exercises.explain: might 表示不确定的推测“可能”。

exercises.q: She has been working all day. She ______ be very tired.
exercises.explain: must 表示非常有把握的肯定推测“一定”。

exercises.q: That man looks like Mr. Wang, but I'm not sure. He ______ be Mr. Wang.
exercises.explain: could 表示不太确定的推测“可能”。

exercises.q: The ground is wet. It ______ have rained last night.
exercises.explain: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测。

exercises.q: He ______ be at home now because I just saw him in the park.
exercises.explain: can't 表示对现在情况的否定推测“不可能”。

exercises.q: A: Where is your sister? B: I don't know. She ______ be in her room.
exercises.explain: might 表示不确定的推测，符合“不知道”的语境。

exercises.q: The sentence "He must be a student" means the speaker is very sure he is a student.
exercises.explain: must 表示非常有把握的肯定推测。

exercises.q: "She can't be at school" means she is definitely at school.
exercises.explain: can't 表示否定推测“不可能”，意思是她不可能在学校。

exercises.q: It is possible that he is at home. (用 might 改写)
exercises.explain: might 表示“可能”，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: I'm sure she is tired. (用 must 改写)
exercises.explain: must 表示有把握的肯定推测。

exercises.q: It is impossible that he is the thief. (用 can't 改写)
exercises.explain: can't 表示否定推测“不可能”。

exercises.q: He musts be at home now.
exercises.answer: He must be at home now.
exercises.explain: 情态动词后接动词原形，must 不加 s。

exercises.q: She can't is a teacher because she is too young.
exercises.answer: She can't be a teacher because she is too young.
exercises.explain: can't 后接动词原形 be，不能接 is。

exercises.q: You look pale. You ______ be ill. You should see a doctor.
exercises.explain: could 表示可能性，语气比 must 弱，符合“脸色苍白可能生病”的推测。

exercises.q: The door is locked and the windows are closed. They ______ be at home.
exercises.explain: 门锁着、窗关着，推测他们不可能在家，用 can't。

exercises.q: I'm not sure about the answer. It ______ be correct, but I need to check.
exercises.explain: might 表示不确定的推测，与“不确定”语境一致。

exercises.q: He ______ have finished the work already. He only started ten minutes ago.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测“不可能已经完成”。

exercises.q: The phone is ringing. It ______ be my mother. She always calls at this time.
exercises.explain: must 表示有把握的肯定推测，与“总是这个时间打电话”相符。

exercises.q: They ______ have gone to the cinema because their car is not in the garage.
exercises.explain: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测。

exercises.q: She ______ be angry with me. She didn't even say hello this morning.
exercises.explain: might 表示对现在情况的可能性推测。

exercises.q: He ______ have stolen the money. He was with me all day yesterday.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测。

exercises.q: "He could be at the library" means the speaker is certain he is at the library.
exercises.explain: could 表示可能性，不是确定。

exercises.q: "She must have left early" means the speaker is quite sure she left early.
exercises.explain: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测。

exercises.q: It is possible that they missed the bus. (用 might 改写)
exercises.answer: They might have missed the bus.
exercises.explain: might have done 表示对过去情况的可能性推测。

exercises.q: I'm sure he has heard the news. (用 must 改写)
exercises.answer: He must have heard the news.
exercises.explain: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测。

exercises.q: It is impossible that she said that. (用 can't 改写)
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测。

exercises.q: He must has forgotten my birthday.
exercises.answer: He must have forgotten my birthday.
exercises.explain: must have done 中 have 用原形，不用 has。

exercises.q: They can't have went to the party because they were sick.
exercises.answer: They can't have gone to the party because they were sick.
exercises.explain: can't have done 中 done 是过去分词，went 应改为 gone。

exercises.q: Given the evidence we have collected, the suspect ______ have been at the scene of the crime.
exercises.explain: might have done 表示对过去情况的可能性推测，符合“根据证据推测”的语境。

exercises.q: She ______ have received my message. I sent it only a minute ago.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测，一分钟前刚发不可能已收到。

exercises.q: The lights in his office are still on. He ______ be working late again.
exercises.explain: must 表示有把握的肯定推测，灯还亮着说明他一定在加班。

exercises.q: I'm not entirely convinced by his story. He ______ be telling the truth, but something doesn't add up.
exercises.explain: could 表示可能性，与“不完全相信”的语气相符。

exercises.q: With such a high fever, she ______ be feeling very uncomfortable right now.
exercises.explain: must 表示对现在情况的肯定推测，高烧一定很难受。

exercises.q: The ground is covered with snow. It ______ have snowed heavily last night.
exercises.explain: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测。

exercises.q: He ______ have been to Beijing before because he knows the city so well.
exercises.explain: must have done 表示对过去经历的肯定推测。

exercises.q: She ______ have forgotten about the meeting. She never misses important events.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测。

exercises.q: "He could have been delayed by traffic" expresses a past possibility.
exercises.explain: could have done 表示对过去情况的可能性推测。

exercises.q: "She must be at home now" and "She must have been at home" express the same degree of certainty about the present.
exercises.explain: 前者推测现在，后者推测过去，时间不同。

exercises.q: It is possible that he was unaware of the consequences. (用 might 改写)
exercises.answer: He might have been unaware of the consequences.
exercises.explain: might have done 表示对过去情况的可能性推测。

exercises.q: I'm certain that she has already made up her mind. (用 must 改写)
exercises.answer: She must have already made up her mind.
exercises.explain: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测。

exercises.q: It is impossible that he completed the project alone. (用 can't 改写)
exercises.answer: He can't have completed the project alone.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测。

exercises.q: She must have went to the airport to pick up her friend.
exercises.answer: She must have gone to the airport to pick up her friend.
exercises.explain: must have done 中 done 是过去分词，went 应改为 gone。

exercises.q: They can't have been knowing about the surprise party.
exercises.answer: They can't have known about the surprise party.
exercises.explain: can't have done 中 done 用过去分词 known，不用 been knowing。

exercises.q: The lights are on in the classroom. Someone ______ be in there.
exercises.explain: 灯亮着是较确定的迹象，用 must 表示“一定”的肯定推测。

exercises.q: I'm not sure where Tom is. He ______ be in the library.
exercises.explain: 不确定时用 could 表示“可能”的推测。

exercises.q: She has just eaten two large pizzas. She ______ still be hungry.
exercises.explain: 刚吃了两个大披萨，不可能还饿，用 can't 表示否定推测。

exercises.q: That man looks exactly like Mr. Wang. He ______ be Mr. Wang's brother.
exercises.explain: 长相相似只能说明“可能”是兄弟，用 could 表示中等可能性。

exercises.q: You have been working all day. You ______ be very tired.
exercises.explain: 工作一整天后累是必然的，用 must 表示很有把握的推测。

exercises.q: The ground is wet. It ______ have rained last night.
exercises.explain: 地面湿是昨晚下过雨的可靠迹象，用 must have done 表示对过去的肯定推测。

exercises.q: I don't know the answer. You ______ ask the teacher.
exercises.explain: 此处 could 表示建议“可以”，语气比 must 委婉。

exercises.q: He ______ be at home now because his car is not in the garage.
exercises.explain: 车不在车库是“不可能在家”的依据，用 can't 表示否定推测。

exercises.q: The sentence "He must be a doctor" means the speaker is completely sure he is a doctor.
exercises.explain: must 表示非常有把握的肯定推测，相当于“一定是”。

exercises.q: In the sentence "She could be at home", "could" is the past tense of "can".
exercises.explain: 这里的 could 表示现在或将来的可能性，不是 can 的过去式。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "could": It is possible that social media makes people feel lonely.
exercises.answer: Social media could make people feel lonely.
exercises.explain: 用 could 替代 It is possible that... 表达可能性。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "must": I am sure that he is at school now.
exercises.answer: He must be at school now.
exercises.explain: 对现在情况的肯定推测用 must be。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "can't": It is impossible that she is older than me.
exercises.answer: She can't be older than me.
exercises.explain: 否定推测用 can't be，表示“不可能”。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He musts be very rich because he has three cars.
exercises.answer: He must be very rich because he has three cars.
exercises.explain: 情态动词后接动词原形，must 不能加 s。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She can't is at home because the lights are off.
exercises.answer: She can't be at home because the lights are off.
exercises.explain: can't 后直接接动词原形 be，不能加 is。

exercises.q: He ______ have gone to Beijing, but I'm not entirely sure.
exercises.explain: 对过去情况不确定时用 might have done 表示“可能已经”。

exercises.q: The door is locked and the windows are closed. They ______ have left already.
exercises.explain: 门锁窗闭是已经离开的有力证据，用 must have done 表示肯定推测。

exercises.q: She ______ be at the meeting right now because I just saw her in the cafeteria.
exercises.explain: 刚在餐厅看到她，所以不可能在开会，用 can't 表示否定推测。

exercises.q: With so much homework to do, he ______ be feeling stressed these days.
exercises.explain: 作业多可能导致压力大，用 could 表示合理的可能性。

exercises.q: You ______ be joking! That can't be true.
exercises.explain: “你一定在开玩笑”是说话者强烈的推测，用 must 表示肯定。

exercises.q: I can't find my keys anywhere. I ______ have left them in the office.
exercises.explain: 找不到钥匙时对过去情况的推测用 might have done，表示“可能”。

exercises.q: The cake is gone. Someone ______ have eaten it.
exercises.explain: 蛋糕不见了，肯定有人吃掉了，用 must have done 表示对过去的肯定推测。

exercises.q: He looks very pale. He ______ be feeling sick.
exercises.explain: 脸色苍白可能是生病了，用 could 表示可能性。

exercises.q: "They can't have finished the project already" means it is impossible that they finished the project already.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测，意为“不可能已经”。

exercises.q: "He might be sleeping" and "He must be sleeping" express the same degree of certainty.
exercises.explain: might 表示可能性较低，must 表示很有把握，两者确定性不同。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "must have done": I am sure that she forgot about the appointment.
exercises.answer: She must have forgotten about the appointment.
exercises.explain: 对过去情况的肯定推测用 must have done。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "can't have done": It is impossible that he saw me at the party.
exercises.answer: He can't have seen me at the party.
exercises.explain: 对过去情况的否定推测用 can't have done。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "could": It is possible that the news is true.
exercises.explain: 用 could be 表达对现在情况的可能性推测。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He must has finished his homework by now.
exercises.answer: He must have finished his homework by now.
exercises.explain: must 后接 have done 表示对过去的推测，不能用 has。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She could be at home yesterday because she didn't answer the phone.
exercises.answer: She could have been at home yesterday because she didn't answer the phone.
exercises.explain: 对过去情况的推测要用 could have been，不能用 could be。

exercises.q: Given the evidence we have collected, the suspect ______ have been at the scene of the crime at the time of the incident.
exercises.explain: 证据不足时用 could have been 表示“可能曾在”，语气不如 must 确定。

exercises.q: The theory that social media use ______ lead to increased feelings of isolation has gained considerable support among researchers.
exercises.explain: 理论中的可能性用 could 表示，符合学术语境中谨慎推测的语气。

exercises.q: He ______ have received my message, because he replied within minutes.
exercises.explain: 几分钟内回复说明一定收到了，用 must have done 表示肯定推测。

exercises.q: The results of the experiment ______ be interpreted as evidence that the hypothesis is correct, though further research is needed.
exercises.explain: 实验结果“可以被解读为”证据，用 could 表示一种可能的解读。

exercises.q: She ______ have been at the concert last night, since she was seen at a restaurant across town at the same time.
exercises.explain: 同一时间在城另一边的餐厅，不可能在音乐会，用 can't have been 表示否定推测。

exercises.q: The ancient ruins ______ have been a temple, but archaeologists are still debating their original purpose.
exercises.explain: 考古学家仍在争论，说明不确定，用 might have been 表示对过去的可能性推测。

exercises.q: Given her extensive background in linguistics, she ______ be the most qualified candidate for the position.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语：从基本用法到与不定式的语域差异
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject: Basic Usage and Gerund vs. Infinitive
grammar.usage:
动名词作主语的核心结构是“动名词短语 + 单数谓语动词”。动名词由“动词原形 + -ing”构成，具有名词性质，可以充当句子主语。当动名词短语作主语时，无论短语内部包含多少名词或修饰成分，谓语动词一律用单数形式，例如：Staying in touch with friends and family on social media can be beneficial. 这里的 Staying in touch with... 整体是一个动名词短语，谓语用 can be。

肯定句结构为：动名词短语 + 谓语动词（单数）。否定句在动名词前加 not，例如：Not getting enough sleep affects your health. 疑问句既可以采用一般疑问句的倒装形式，如：Is learning a foreign language difficult? 也可以使用 it 作形式主语的疑问形式，如：Is it worth spending so much time on social media? 在书面语和正式文体中，用 it 作形式主语后接动名词的句式较为常见，例如：It is no use crying over spilt milk.

动名词与不定式作主语的核心区别在于：动名词通常表示一般的、习惯性的、抽象的或已知的行为；不定式通常表示具体的、一次性的或将来的行为。例如：Smoking is bad for health.（泛指吸烟这一行为）与 To finish this task today is my goal.（具体某一次的目标）。在高中阶段，这一区别进一步延伸到语域和文体层面：动名词作主语更常见于书面语、议论文和说明文，语气更客观、抽象；不定式作主语在口语和文学性较强的表达中更常见，且常与 it 作形式主语的结构搭配，如 It is important to learn English well.

初中阶段主要要求掌握动名词作主语的基本结构、主谓一致以及常见动名词短语的识别。高中阶段则要求进一步掌握：动名词作主语与不定式作主语的语域差异、动名词的复合结构作主语（如 His coming late made the teacher angry）、动名词作主语时使用 it 作形式主语的特定句型（如 It is no use / no good / worthwhile + doing），以及在书面表达中主动运用动名词作主语来提升句式的多样性和正式感。

易错点一：动名词短语作主语时，谓语动词容易受短语末尾名词的影响而误用复数。例如：Reading books is my hobby. 不能说 Reading books are my hobby. 因为主语是 Reading 这个动名词，books 只是动名词的宾语。

易错点二：否定动名词时，not 的位置容易放错。否定词 not 应放在动名词之前，而不是谓语动词之前。例如：Not exercising regularly can lead to health problems. 不能说 Exercising not regularly can lead to health problems.

易错点三：动名词与不定式作主语时，语义差别容易被忽略。在高考书面表达中，如果描述普遍现象或抽象行为，应优先使用动名词作主语；如果描述具体计划或某一次行为，应使用不定式。例如：Helping others makes us happy.（普遍行为）与 To help him with his homework is my plan for today.（具体计划）。

易错点四：it 作形式主语时，动名词和不定式的搭配句型不同。It is no use / no good / worthwhile 后接动名词，而 It is important / necessary / difficult 后接不定式。混淆这两类句型是高中写作中的常见错误。
forms: 动名词短语 + 单数谓语动词：Learning a foreign language takes time and patience.
否定：Not + 动名词短语 + 单数谓语动词：Not getting enough sleep affects your health.
一般疑问句：Is + 动名词短语 + 其他成分？：Is learning a foreign language difficult?
it 作形式主语：It is no use / no good / worthwhile + 动名词短语：It is no use crying over spilt milk.
动名词复合结构作主语：名词所有格/物主代词 + 动名词 + 单数谓语：His coming late made the teacher angry.
与不定式对比：动名词（一般/抽象行为） vs. 不定式（具体/将来行为）：Smoking is bad for health. vs. To finish this task today is my goal.
notes: 动名词短语作主语时，谓语动词必须用单数，不要被短语末尾的名词干扰。例如：Reading books is my hobby. 不能说 are。
否定动名词时，not 要放在动名词之前，而不是谓语动词之前。例如：Not exercising regularly can lead to health problems.
高考书面表达中，描述普遍现象、抽象行为或习惯性动作时，优先用动名词作主语，能提升句式的正式感和客观性。
it 作形式主语时，动名词和不定式的搭配句型不同：It is no use / no good / worthwhile + doing，而 It is important / necessary / difficult + to do，书面语中不可混用。
动名词作主语与不定式作主语在语域上有差异：动名词更偏书面语和议论文，不定式更偏口语和具体语境。高考写作中应根据文体选择。

grammar.key: Adverb Clauses of Condition (with 'if') / 条件状语从句（if引导）
grammar.title: if 引导的条件状语从句（含 unless / as long as / 主将从现拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Adverb Clauses of Condition with if (including unless, as long as, and tense patterns)
grammar.usage:
if 引导的条件状语从句表示主句动作发生所依赖的条件，常译为“如果……”。核心结构为：if + 从句（条件），主句（结果）。主句和从句的位置可以互换，从句在前时通常用逗号隔开，从句在后时一般不用逗号。肯定形式直接使用 if 引导从句；否定形式可以在从句中用否定词，或使用 unless（除非）来替换 if...not；疑问形式通常体现在主句中，例如“What will you do if it rains tomorrow?”。

在时态上，初中阶段主要掌握“主将从现”：主句用一般将来时或含情态动词，if 从句用一般现在时表示将来。高中阶段则需进一步理解：当表示客观规律、科学事实或习惯性结果时，主句和从句都用一般现在时，即“主现从现”；当表示对过去情况的假设时，使用虚拟语气，即 if 从句用过去完成时，主句用 would/could/might have done。此外，高中还要求能识别 if 引导宾语从句表示“是否”的用法，此时时态不受“主将从现”限制。

与近义结构对比：unless 相当于 if...not，但语气更强，常译为“除非”；as long as 和 so long as 表示“只要”，强调唯一必要条件；in case 表示“以防、万一”，带有目的意味；provided/providing that 多用于书面语，表示“在……条件下”。这些结构在语义和语域上与 if 有细微差别，高中写作中可根据语境选择使用。

易错点：一是把 if 从句中的一般现在时误写成一般将来时；二是混淆 if 引导条件状语从句和宾语从句的时态规则；三是在书面表达中过度使用 if，不善于用 unless、as long as 等替换以增加句式多样性；四是在虚拟条件句中混用真实条件句的时态。
forms: If + 一般现在时，主句 + will/can/may/must + 动词原形（主将从现）
If + 一般现在时，主句 + 一般现在时（客观事实/习惯）
If + 过去完成时，主句 + would/could/might have done（虚拟，与过去事实相反）
Unless + 从句，主句（= If...not）
As long as / So long as + 从句，主句（只要……）
主句 + if + 从句（从句后置，不加逗号）
notes: 高考书面表达中，if 条件句的时态错误是常见失分点，务必检查主句和从句的时态搭配是否符合“主将从现”或虚拟语气规则。
if 引导宾语从句表示“是否”时，从句时态根据实际时间决定，不受条件句规则约束，例如：I don't know if he will come tomorrow.
在正式书面语中，unless 比 if...not 更简洁有力，但要注意 unless 本身已含否定意义，从句中不能再加否定词。
虚拟条件句中，如果 if 从句含有 were、had、should，可省略 if 并倒装，如：Had I known earlier, I would have helped you. 这是高考语法填空和写作的高级用法。
as long as 引导条件句时，强调“只要满足这个条件即可”，在议论文中常用于提出建议或说明前提，比 if 更具论证色彩。

examples.cn: 如果你努力学习，你就会通过考试。

examples.en: Please call me if you need any help.
examples.cn: 如果你需要任何帮助，请给我打电话。

examples.cn: 如果明天下雨，我们就取消野餐。

examples.en: You won't improve your writing unless you practice every day.
examples.cn: 除非你每天练习，否则你的写作不会提高。

examples.en: As long as you stay focused, you can finish the project on time.
examples.cn: 只要你保持专注，你就能按时完成这个项目。

examples.en: Had the government acted sooner, the crisis might have been avoided.
examples.cn: 如果政府更早采取行动，这场危机或许本可以避免。

exercises.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: if引导的条件状语从句中，主句用将来时，从句用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: You will be late for school ______ you don't get up early.
exercises.explain: if引导条件状语从句，表示"如果"，符合句意。

exercises.q: If you ______ hard, you can pass the exam.
exercises.explain: 主句含有情态动词can，if从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: ______ he comes, I will tell him the news.
exercises.explain: if引导条件状语从句，表示"如果"。

exercises.q: If she ______ free tomorrow, she will go shopping with us.
exercises.explain: if从句中用一般现在时表示将来，主语she是第三人称单数，用is。

exercises.q: If he ______ (come) to the party, I will be very happy.
exercises.explain: if条件句中用一般现在时表示将来，主语he是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: We will go to the park if it ______ (not rain) tomorrow.
exercises.explain: if条件句中用一般现在时表示将来，否定形式用doesn't rain。

exercises.q: If you ______ (feel) tired, you can have a rest.
exercises.explain: 主句有情态动词can，if从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
exercises.explain: if条件句中不能用将来时，应改为一般现在时rains。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
exercises.explain: 主句用将来时，if从句用一般现在时，符合主将从现规则。

exercises.q: If you don't study hard, you won't pass the exam. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
exercises.explain: 将if从句和主句都改为肯定形式，保持主将从现。

exercises.q: We will go swimming if it is sunny. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: We won't go swimming if it isn't sunny.
exercises.explain: 将主句和if从句都改为否定形式。

exercises.q: If you eat too much, you will get fat. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will I get fat if I eat too much?
exercises.explain: 将主句改为一般疑问句，if从句保持一般现在时。

exercises.q: If he will come tomorrow, I will call you.
exercises.answer: If he comes tomorrow, I will call you.
exercises.explain: if条件句中不能用将来时，应改为一般现在时comes。

exercises.q: She will be happy if you will help her.
exercises.answer: She will be happy if you help her.
exercises.explain: if条件句中用一般现在时help，不用将来时。

exercises.q: If I ______ enough money, I will buy a new bike.
exercises.explain: 主句用将来时，if从句用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: You can't enter the cinema ______ you have a ticket.
exercises.explain: unless表示"除非"，相当于if...not，符合句意。

exercises.q: If it ______ fine tomorrow, we will go hiking.
exercises.explain: if条件句中用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: ______ you don't feel well, you should see a doctor.
exercises.explain: if引导条件状语从句，表示"如果"。

exercises.q: If you ______ to the party, you will meet many old friends.
exercises.explain: if条件句中用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: If you ______ (not leave) now, you will miss the train.
exercises.explain: if条件句中用一般现在时，否定形式用don't leave。

exercises.q: We will have a picnic if the weather ______ (be) nice.
exercises.explain: if条件句中用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: If she ______ (ask) me for help, I will help her.
exercises.explain: if条件句中用一般现在时，主语she是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: If you will come to my house, I will show you my new computer.
exercises.explain: if条件句中不能用将来时，应改为一般现在时come。

exercises.q: Unless you study harder, you won't pass the exam.
exercises.explain: unless相当于if...not，主句用将来时，从句用一般现在时，符合规则。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you will be late. (用unless改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you hurry, you will be late.
exercises.explain: unless相当于if...not，将if you don't hurry改为unless you hurry。

exercises.q: We will go to the beach if it doesn't rain. (用unless改写)
exercises.answer: We will go to the beach unless it rains.
exercises.explain: unless相当于if...not，将if it doesn't rain改为unless it rains。

exercises.q: If you are tired, you can go to bed early. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Can I go to bed early if I am tired?
exercises.explain: 将主句改为一般疑问句，if从句保持一般现在时。

exercises.q: If it won't rain, we will play football outside.
exercises.answer: If it doesn't rain, we will play football outside.
exercises.explain: if条件句中不能用将来时，应改为一般现在时doesn't rain。

exercises.q: You will catch a cold if you will wear wet clothes.
exercises.answer: You will catch a cold if you wear wet clothes.
exercises.explain: if条件句中用一般现在时wear，不用将来时。

exercises.q: If I ______ you, I would apologize to her immediately.
exercises.explain: 这是与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，if从句用过去时were。

exercises.q: If he had studied harder, he ______ the exam last week.
exercises.explain: 这是与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，主句用would have done。

exercises.q: I don't know ______ he will come to the meeting or not.
exercises.explain: whether引导宾语从句表示"是否"，可与or not连用，if不能与or not直接连用。

exercises.q: ______ it rains tomorrow, the sports meeting will be put off.
exercises.explain: if引导条件状语从句，表示"如果"，符合句意。

exercises.q: If you ______ the early bus, you won't get there on time.
exercises.explain: 主句用将来时，if从句用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: If I ______ (be) you, I would take the job.
exercises.explain: 虚拟条件句中，if从句用过去时were表示与现在事实相反。

exercises.q: If she ______ (arrive) earlier, she would have met the famous singer.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，if从句用过去完成时had arrived。

exercises.q: We will go to the concert if we ______ (get) tickets.
exercises.explain: 主句用将来时，if从句用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: If I had known the truth, I would tell you now.
exercises.explain: if从句用过去完成时表示与过去事实相反，主句应用would have told。

exercises.q: If it snows tomorrow, we will make a snowman.
exercises.explain: 主句用将来时，if从句用一般现在时，符合主将从现规则。

exercises.q: If you don't work hard, you won't succeed. (用unless改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you work hard, you won't succeed.
exercises.explain: unless相当于if...not，将if you don't work hard改为unless you work hard。

exercises.q: He didn't pass the exam because he didn't study hard. (用if改写为虚拟语气)
exercises.answer: If he had studied hard, he would have passed the exam.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，if从句用过去完成时，主句用would have done。

exercises.q: I am not rich, so I can't buy that house. (用if改写为虚拟语气)
exercises.answer: If I were rich, I could buy that house.
exercises.explain: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，if从句用过去时were，主句用could do。

exercises.q: If I was you, I would accept the offer.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
exercises.explain: 虚拟条件句中，if从句用were而不是was。

exercises.q: If he will come tomorrow, please tell him to call me.
exercises.answer: If he comes tomorrow, please tell him to call me.
exercises.explain: if条件句中用一般现在时comes，不用将来时。

exercises.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: if 条件句中用一般现在时表示将来，主句用 will。

exercises.q: You ______ miss the bus if you don't get up early.
exercises.explain: 主句表示将来结果，用 will，构成第一条件句。

exercises.q: If she ______ hard, she can pass the exam.
exercises.explain: 主句有情态动词 can，if 从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If you feel lonely, you ______ talk to your parents.
exercises.explain: could 表示建议，情态动词后直接接动词原形。

exercises.q: ______ he comes late again, the teacher will be angry.
exercises.explain: if 引导条件状语从句，表示“如果”。

exercises.q: If you ______ (need) help, please call me.
exercises.explain: if 条件句用一般现在时，主语是 you，动词用原形。

exercises.q: We will go for a picnic if the weather ______ (be) nice.
exercises.explain: if 条件句用一般现在时表示将来，主语 weather 用 is。

exercises.q: If he ______ (not hurry), he will be late for school.
exercises.explain: if 条件句用一般现在时，否定形式用 doesn't + 动词原形。

exercises.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
exercises.explain: if 条件句中不能用 will，应用一般现在时 rains。

exercises.q: If you study hard, you can get good grades.
exercises.explain: 主句有情态动词 can，if 从句用一般现在时，结构正确。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you will miss the train. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: If you hurry, you will catch the train.
exercises.explain: 将否定条件改为肯定条件，主句结果相应变为肯定。

exercises.q: We will stay at home if it rains. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will you stay at home if it rains?
exercises.explain: 将主句改为一般疑问句，if 从句保持一般现在时。

exercises.q: If you feel sad, you can talk to me. (用 could 改写)
exercises.answer: If you feel sad, you could talk to me.
exercises.explain: could 比 can 语气更委婉，仍表示建议。

exercises.q: If he will come, I will tell you.
exercises.answer: If he comes, I will tell you.
exercises.explain: if 条件句中用一般现在时 comes，不用 will come。

exercises.q: You can to ask the teacher if you have questions.
exercises.answer: You can ask the teacher if you have questions.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形，不能加 to。

exercises.q: If I ______ enough money, I would buy a new computer.
exercises.explain: 这是第二条件句，表示与现在事实相反的假设，if 从句用过去时。

exercises.q: If she had studied harder, she ______ the exam.
exercises.explain: 第三条件句表示与过去事实相反，主句用 would have + 过去分词。

exercises.q: You can borrow my book ______ you return it by Friday.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，引导条件状语从句。

exercises.q: ______ you don't water the plants, they will die.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if...not，表示“如果不”。

exercises.q: If I were you, I ______ apologize to her.
exercises.explain: If I were you 是虚拟语气，主句用 would 表示建议。

exercises.q: If he ______ (be) more careful, he wouldn't have made that mistake.
exercises.explain: 第三条件句 if 从句用过去完成时 had been。

exercises.q: We will go hiking unless it ______ (rain) heavily.
exercises.explain: unless 引导条件从句，用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: If you ______ (tell) me earlier, I could have helped you.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件，if 从句用过去完成时。

exercises.q: If I would have known about the party, I would have gone.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 would have，应用 had known。

exercises.q: Unless you practice regularly, you won't improve your English.
exercises.explain: unless 表示“如果不”，从句用一般现在时，结构正确。

exercises.q: If you don't leave now, you will miss the bus. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you leave now, you will miss the bus.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if...not，可替换否定条件句。

exercises.q: I didn't know the truth, so I didn't tell you. (用 if 改写为虚拟语气)
exercises.answer: If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件，用第三条件句。

exercises.q: If you heat ice, it melts. (改为同义句，用 when)
exercises.answer: When you heat ice, it melts.
exercises.explain: 表示客观事实时，if 和 when 可以互换。

exercises.q: If I was you, I would take that job.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would take that job.
exercises.explain: 虚拟语气中 If I were you 是固定表达，用 were 不用 was。

exercises.q: She would have passed the test if she studied harder.
exercises.answer: She would have passed the test if she had studied harder.
exercises.explain: 第三条件句 if 从句应用过去完成时 had studied。

exercises.q: Had I known about the traffic jam, I ______ a different route.
exercises.explain: 省略 if 的倒装虚拟条件句，主句用 would have done。

exercises.q: If the government ______ stricter regulations, the pollution crisis might not have escalated.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件，if 从句用过去完成时。

exercises.q: ______ you encounter any difficulties, do not hesitate to contact me.
exercises.explain: Should 引导倒装条件句，相当于 If you should encounter。

exercises.q: The project will proceed ______ unforeseen circumstances arise.
exercises.explain: unless 表示“除非”，引出使主句不成立的条件。

exercises.q: If he ______ more prudent in his investments, he wouldn't have gone bankrupt.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件，用过去完成时 had been。

exercises.q: ______ it not been for your timely intervention, the situation would have deteriorated.
exercises.explain: 省略 if 的倒装虚拟条件句，Had it not been for 表示“要不是”。

exercises.q: If she ______ (not neglect) her health, she might not be hospitalized now.
exercises.explain: 混合虚拟语气，if 从句与过去事实相反，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: Provided that all parties ______ (agree), the contract will be signed tomorrow.
exercises.explain: provided that 引导条件从句，用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: Were the committee to reject the proposal, the entire initiative would collapse.
exercises.explain: Were 引导的倒装虚拟条件句，结构正确，表示与将来事实相反的假设。

exercises.q: If he would have been more transparent, the scandal could have been avoided.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 would have been，应用 had been。

exercises.q: If you had informed us earlier, we could have taken preventive measures. (改为倒装句)
exercises.answer: Had you informed us earlier, we could have taken preventive measures.
exercises.explain: 省略 if，将 had 提前构成倒装虚拟条件句。

exercises.q: But for your support, I would have failed. (用 if 改写)
exercises.answer: If it had not been for your support, I would have failed.
exercises.explain: But for 相当于 If it had not been for，表示“要不是”。

exercises.q: If you should need any assistance, please let me know. (改为倒装句)
exercises.answer: Should you need any assistance, please let me know.
exercises.explain: 省略 if，将 should 提前构成倒装条件句。

exercises.q: If the data had been analyzed more thoroughly, the researchers would publish their findings sooner.
exercises.answer: If the data had been analyzed more thoroughly, the researchers would have published their findings sooner.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件，主句应用 would have published。

grammar.key: Relative Clauses (who/that) / 定语从句（who/that引导）
grammar.title: 定语从句（who/that 引导）——从基础到高考拓展（含 whom/whose/介词+whom）
grammar.titleEn: Relative Clauses with who/that (Extended: whom, whose, preposition + whom)
grammar.usage:
定语从句（Relative Clause）在句中相当于一个形容词，用来修饰前面的名词或代词，这个被修饰的词叫“先行词”。本讲重点学习由关系代词 who 和 that 引导的定语从句，它们主要用于指人。核心结构为：先行词（人）+ who/that + 从句。who/that 在从句中可以作主语，也可以作宾语；作主语时不能省略，作宾语时在口语或非正式书面语中可以省略。

肯定句结构：先行词（人）+ who/that + 谓语动词……。例如：I know a man who/that works in a hospital. 否定句在从句内部正常否定即可：People who do not sleep well often feel tired. 疑问句则是在主句层面进行变化：Do you know the girl who is standing at the gate? 需要注意的是，定语从句本身不因主句是疑问句而改变语序。

who 与 that 在指人时常常可以互换，但在高中阶段需要进一步区分：who 更正式、更常见于书面语；that 在口语中更自然。此外，当先行词被最高级、序数词、the only、the very、all、any 等修饰时，习惯上更倾向用 that。初中阶段主要掌握 who/that 作主语和宾语的基本用法；高中阶段则要拓展到 whom（作宾语，正式语域）、whose（作定语，表示所属关系）以及“介词 + whom”结构，例如：The person with whom I talked was very helpful. 在书面语中，介词提前时只能用 whom，不能用 who 或 that。

易错点一：关系代词作主语时，从句谓语动词的人称和数必须与先行词一致，而不是与 who/that 一致。例如：The boy who is playing over there is my brother.（先行词 boy 是单数，谓语用 is。）易错点二：关系代词作宾语时可以省略，但作主语时绝对不能省略。易错点三：介词提前时，指人只能用 whom，不能用 who/that。易错点四：不要在主句中重复使用代词指代先行词，例如不能说：The man who he came yesterday is my uncle. 应去掉 he。
forms: 先行词（人）+ who + 谓语动词（作主语，不可省略）
先行词（人）+ that + 谓语动词（作主语，不可省略）
先行词（人）+ (who/that) + 主语 + 谓语（作宾语，可省略）
先行词（人）+ whom + 主语 + 谓语（作宾语，正式语域）
先行词（人）+ whose + 名词 + 谓语（作定语，表示所属）
介词 + whom + 主语 + 谓语（介词提前，只能用 whom）
notes: who/that 在从句中作主语时不能省略；作宾语时在口语或非正式书面语中可以省略，但在高考书面表达中，正式文体建议保留关系代词。
从句谓语动词的数必须与先行词一致，而不是与 who/that 一致。高考语法填空常考主谓一致：The students who are (be) chosen will attend the meeting.
介词提前时，指人只能用 whom，不能用 who 或 that。例如：The man to whom you spoke is our headmaster. 这是高考书面语和语法填空的高频考点。
whose 表示所属关系，既可指人也可指物，高考中常与 of which 进行同义转换。例如：The house whose roof is red is mine. = The house the roof of which is red is mine.
避免在主句中重复使用代词指代先行词。例如：The girl who she won the prize is my classmate.（错误，应去掉 she）
